review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse activity retrieval API and frontend support, including parameters for warehouse source, query status, recency, and pagination, and distinguishes between completed and running warehouse jobs.
review.reason: The observed changes add warehouse activity API parameters and response fields, typed parameters, URL construction, and frontend implementation. This supports warehouse users in filtering warehouse activity by warehouse source, warehouse query, warehouse query type, recency, and warehouse query status, and retrieving warehouse activity including both completed and running jobs.
